core_research_question: Can a small set of residue-pair distances reconstruct other, unobserved distance changes in an independent simulation of the same molecular system? Does selecting measurements using a worst-case transfer objective across independent training runs improve that reconstruction compared with established alternatives?

eligible_pair_criteria: Reference distance at frame 0: d_ij(0) <= 2.0 nm (20.0 Angstroms)
measurement_space.disjoint_guarantee: C intersection T is strictly empty (C cap T = empty)

common_decoder.loss: Mean Squared Error (MSE) on original distance units (nm)
common_decoder.feature_standardization: Fitted strictly on development runs, applied to test
common_decoder.tuning_strategy: Inner cross-run validation across the two development runs

evaluated_selectors.name: Training-Mean Baseline
evaluated_selectors.description: Predicts the static mean of each target from development runs (time-invariant).

evaluated_selectors.name: Random Candidate Selection
evaluated_selectors.description: Randomly selects k candidate features from C across 20 fixed seeds (1..20).

evaluated_selectors.name: Highest Variance Selection
evaluated_selectors.description: Selects top-k candidate features with largest variance in training runs.

evaluated_selectors.name: PCA with Pivoted-QR Selection
evaluated_selectors.description: Extracts top-k PCA loadings of C in training runs, performs column-pivoted QR.

evaluated_selectors.name: Information Imbalance (DII-equivalent)
evaluated_selectors.description: Greedy forward selection minimizing distance information imbalance to target panel.

evaluated_selectors.name: Ordinary Pooled-Training Greedy Selector
evaluated_selectors.description: Greedy forward selection minimizing pooled development MSE.

evaluated_selectors.name: Matched Mean-Transfer Selector
evaluated_selectors.description: Greedy forward selection minimizing J_mean = (E_1_to_2 + E_2_to_1) / 2.

evaluated_selectors.name: Proposed Worst-Transfer (Robust) Selector
evaluated_selectors.description: Greedy forward selection minimizing J_robust = max(E_1_to_2, E_2_to_1).

evaluated_selectors.name: Graph-Assisted Robust Selector
evaluated_selectors.description: Chara exponential Laplacian heat kernel diffusion prior combined with robust transfer.

negative_controls.description: Circularly shifts test candidate inputs by 150 frames (75 ns) relative to targets.
